intentional_contract_changes.what: unknown projectId now denied with no-oracle 404 instead of falling through to tier logic

test_infra_changes.what: db fixture: in-memory sqlite -> per-test file-backed sqlite
test_infra_changes.why: in-memory multiplexes all sessions on ONE StaticPool connection; concurrent poller auth SELECTs/rollbacks clobbered the background re-index's open transaction (reproduced: 8 chunks counted, 4-6 rows persisted). File-backed isolation mirrors the asyncpg pool.

decisions: No new tables/migrations; build on context_chunks (0030), live git, in-memory job registry
git-search has no client repoPath field; root resolves server-side from latest index job (fail closed)
secret redaction is precision-first (PEM/AWS/GitHub/Slack/OpenAI-style/Google/JWT); no fuzzy password heuristics
search-multi embeds the query exactly once; all listed projects authorized before any work; one foreign id denies the whole call
ranking: deterministic ties (-score, path, startLine); budget skips-and-continues with droppedForBudget counted, never silent
needs_integration: Durable repo-root registry (latest_job_root is in-memory; freshness/git-search 404 after restart) - migration lane (A1)
Execution-side injection of ranked bundle (VR005/VR006 context->execution) - A2-S2
